 Samhällsbyggnadsbolaget i Norden AB (publ) Expects SEK 177M Finnish Tax Refund
 Less than 1 min read SBB_B Samhällsbyggnadsbolaget i Norden AB (publ) will receive a EUR 16M tax refund, approximately SEK 177M at today’s exchange rate. The one-off refund excludes interest and is expected to reduce Q4 2026 tax expense by the amount refunded; no prior-period comparison was provided. 
 Material Details 
 # Detail AI Analyst View 
 1 Refund of EUR 16M, about SEK 177M One-off cash inflow strengthens liquidity; the amount excludes interest, so total inflow is expected to be slightly higher. 
 2 Q4 2026 tax expense falls by refund amount The refund is expected to lift Q4 earnings through lower tax expense, but it is not recurring. 
 3 Follows favourable Finnish tax reassessment decision Resolves a two-year reassessment process and enables the refund. 
 Context by AI Analyst 
 This is a one-off tax recovery rather than evidence of a recurring operating trend. Receipt of the refund and the Q4 2026 results would confirm the cash inflow and tax-expense impact. 
 Based on the original press release from Samhällsbyggnadsbolaget i Norden AB (publ) distributed by MFN by Modular Finance.
